request.style: English, jazz, female soulful solo voice, upright bass, piano, brushed snare, saxophone, warm and contemplative, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
He called the twelve to stand before him
Gave power over spirits, sickness gone
Simon and Andrew, James and John
Philip and Thomas, Matthew, Thaddaeus
Sent to the lost sheep of Israel
Proclaim the Kingdom is come near

[Pre-Chorus]
No gold in belts, no second tunic
No staff to carry, no bag for road
Freely received it, freely give it
The worker gets his daily bread

[Chorus]
The Kingdom of heaven has come near
Heal the sick, cleanse the leper
Drive out the demons, raise the dead
Freely you have received, freely give

[Verse]
Enter the house, give peace a greeting
If worthy let it rest on them
If not, let peace return to you
Shake the dust off your feet
Be shrewd like serpents, innocent as doves
They will hand you over to councils

[Chorus]
The Kingdom of heaven has come near
Heal the sick, cleanse the leper
Drive out the demons, raise the dead
Freely you have received, freely give

[Bridge]
Do not fear those who kill the body
But fear the one who can destroy both
Two sparrows sold for a single penny
Not one falls without his care
Your head hairs are all numbered
You are worth more than many sparrows

[Outro]
Take up your cross and follow me
Lose your life for my sake, find it
